name: Exploring the Alliance

angles.text: As an Alliance newcomer, you visit its principal strongholds and meet the leaders who hold the pact together.
As a Skyborne guest on Azeroth, you are urged to learn about the allied nations that shelter you while your order prepares to establish itself in Dalaran.

faq.answer: You travel across Azeroth to meet the leaders of the Alliance’s major seats of power. The journey brings you before the rulers of Ironforge and Darnassus, and High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, leader of the gnomes in exile.
faq.q: What is the quest Exploring the Alliance?

faq.answer: Randal Emerson is an attendant in Stormwind Keep’s southern antechamber. He gives travelers directions to the other capital cities.
You visit King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge, High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus. Each leads a core race and holds authority within the Alliance.
faq.q: Which leaders must be visited during this journey?

faq.answer: Your order is preparing to establish its presence in Dalaran. While those arrangements are underway, you are encouraged to learn about Azeroth and aid nearby territories.
faq.q: Why is Dalaran mentioned upon completing the quest?

faq.answer: After returning to Stormwind Keep, you head toward the countryside near the capital, specifically Westfall. Its troubled communities urgently need capable defenders.
faq.q: Where does the path lead after completing this journey?

faq.answer: You are treated as an outsider newly arrived on Azeroth, and are expected to understand the wider world so you can protect and aid your own people. The journey introduces you to the Alliance’s varied cultures.
faq.q: Why is the adventurer treated as a guest of the Alliance?

sections.body: Randal Emerson, an attendant in Stormwind Keep’s southern antechamber, sends you beyond the human capital. Newly arrived on Azeroth, you are invited to see the Alliance’s allied peoples firsthand. The journey takes you beyond the keep to learn the distinct cultures, traditions, and strength of those who stand with Stormwind.
sections.title: A Tour of Allied Lands

sections.body: Your travels cross land and sea to the leaders of the Alliance. In Ironforge, you meet King Magni Bronzebeard in the mountain halls and High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, leader of the displaced gnomes. In Darnassus atop Teldrassil, you meet High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. Their cities and peoples reveal the ties among humans, dwarves, gnomes, and night elves.
sections.title: Audiences with the High Seats

sections.body: After the long journey, you return to Stormwind. Knowing more of Azeroth helps you aid your own people, while your order prepares to establish itself in Dalaran. For now, the troubled territories near the capital need help, beginning with Westfall’s struggling farmlands.
sections.title: A World in Need of Aid

summary: In Stormwind Keep, you begin a journey to meet the rulers of Ironforge and Darnassus. Their lands show you the breadth of the Alliance before you turn toward Westfall.
attribution: In-game quest text: Exploring the Alliance
